about.en: CREO is the token of Creo Engine, a Web3 gaming platform that publishes games, runs the Creoplay distribution and marketplace platform and builds tooling connecting players, developers and partners. The token is a BEP-20 on BNB Chain at 0x9521728bF66a867BC65A93Ece4a543D817871Eb7, with further deployments on Ethereum and Solana.
